<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Android 16''' is one of the androids of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Android Saga|Android Saga]], a little bigger than a player. He is one of the fighters who can be drawn as a contender in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell Games|Cell Games]], and your sparring partner in the Android Saga quest '''The Gentle Giant'''.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the tournament == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
Android 16 is one of the Cell Saga fighters that fill the contender seats of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell Games|Cell Games]] bracket, hosted by [[Special:MyLanguage/Cell|Cell]]. Each run draws its contenders at random, each character at most once, so he isn't in every bracket; the draw is only revealed once everybody accepts the rules. His fellow contenders can include [[Special:MyLanguage/Tien Shinhan|Tien Shinhan]].

<!--T:9-->
His stats come from the seat he is drawn into: by default a contender has between 66,500 and 210,000 health, 2,700 to 8,700 melee damage and 2,420 to 7,820 ki damage, fights on the Novice, Smart or Elite AI tier, and gets 8% stronger for every round already played.

<!--T:10-->
The Cell Games are '''lethal''': losing a bout kills you. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments|Tournaments]] for how bouts work.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:11-->

<!--T:12-->
Android 16 flies.

<!--T:13-->
* '''Ki Wave:''' a large yellow ki wave.
* '''Ki Volley:''' a burst of fast ki blasts.
* '''Melee Combo:''' he teleports around you and lands three hits.
* '''Dodging:''' every so often he steps out of the way of an attack.
* '''Teleporting:''' on the Smart AI tier and above he can also teleport next to his target.

<!--T:14-->
How well he uses them depends on his AI tier (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|enemy AI tiers]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:15-->

<!--T:16-->
In the [[Special:MyLanguage/Android Saga|Android Saga]] quest '''The Gentle Giant''' you spar with Android 16 in Earth's mountains. Spars are non-lethal: he concedes instead of dying.
</translate>
